failures: Nested acceptance subprocess exceeded its 10-second bound and TimeoutExpired escaped.
Hypothesis manifest property exceeded its default 200ms deadline once (253.62ms), then completed in 0.11ms; reported as FlakyFailure, not a property counterexample.

corrections: Acceptance timeouts return a failed sanitized receipt with null exit code and no evidence hash; no retry or timeout increase.
CI selects existing two-worker loadscope lane, preserving all test and coverage gates and 300-second stage caps.

Digest generation uses 32 binary bytes converted to hex, preserving the entire 64-character hexadecimal input space. This reduces generation overhead but does not prevent OS scheduling delays; default property deadlines remain unchanged.

Preservation evaluation and evidence-ledger test subprocesses use per-test output destinations; CLI defaults remain unchanged. This removes identified cross-module output races before enabling parallel CI.

full_followup.scope: Full harness on deployment branch before subsequent preservation/ledger output-isolation tests and integration of newer main. Those changes require separate validation.
